moments.why_standalone: A narrator comes home at dawn to wet footprints on a dry porch that lead only to her door.
Two cameras go up and the new recording shows a light on inside her house that she never leaves on.
A nurse tests an impossible date stamp by taping a note to her door and gets a reply in her own handwriting.
She tries to outrun tomorrow, cuts her hand on broken glass and bandages it.
On the porch at 3:12 the live recording shows a second figure stepping out of her own front door.
